correctness.rationale: Read entire RESULT.md and verify.py. For synchronous three-site binary majority, every zero edge x_i=x_(i+1) persists, making fixed equal adjacent boundary pairs. In each maximal intervening alternating strip of d consecutive unequal edges, the unresolved interior erodes from both ends, last change at floor(d/2); all-one edge word is possible only on an even ring and is an already-periodic 2-cycle. Hence tau_n=floor(D/2), max floor((n-1)/2), and exactly 2n maximizers by parity and cyclic position. The 2L-state directed transfer matrix (j,p), j<L=2t+2, tracks forbidden runs and total edge parity; its closed-walk trace counts 2 spin lifts per permitted even-parity edge word. Add 2 checkerboards for n even. For rare run beginnings 0 1^L, windows of length L+1 have probability 2^(-L-1) (global parity is irrelevant for strict subsets), overlapping starts are incompatible and fixed-order separated starts independent, proving Poisson factorial moments for n*2^(-2t-3)->lambda. Geometric upper/lower tails bound E tau=(log2 n)/2+O(1). Independent newly executed checker exhaustively simulated 8184 states n=3..12, 55 exact transfer traces, sharp maxima, orbit periods; all passed. No numerical sample proves limit; that follows from moments.
